title: Starting an inner multiplication row
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string and let $v$ assign natural numbers to $13$ registers, each at most $4(|x|+1)$. Starting in the state that clears register $9$, with register values $v$ and no answer recorded, the multiplication machine can reach its inner-loop state with register $9$ equal to the initial value of register $2$ and register $10$ equal to the initial value of register $8$, while satisfying its prescribed validity and register-bound conditions at every intermediate step.
hypotheses_covered: Every register value is at most $4(|x|+1)$
